visual_action: A slideshow of still photographs of Barack Obama. He is shown in various settings: sitting in a chair on the phone, walking outdoors in sunglasses holding a drink, walking away from a helicopter, smiling and walking in front of a crowd, standing in front of his official portrait, pointing at the camera in front of an American flag, waving, and speaking at a podium with the presidential seal.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: He is the subject of every photograph shown in the video montage.

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics from a song: "And you wanna scream, don't call me kid, don't call me baby. Look at this god-forsaken mess that you made me. You showed me colors, you know I can't see with anyone else."
audio_music: An emotional, anthemic pop ballad with a female vocalist plays throughout the video.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow of still photographs. The cuts between photos are timed to the music and the appearance of the on-screen text.
cultural_references: The lyrics sung in the audio and displayed on screen are from the Taylor Swift song 'cardigan'.
central_claim: Barack Obama's presidency was a unique and admirable era, the absence of which has led to a "godforsaken mess."
intended_effect: To evoke nostalgia and admiration for Barack Obama, while implying criticism of the current political state.
